title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E20 — The Matchmaker
Geneva's crazy Aunt Eunetta (also played by SAUNDRA QUARTERMAN) comes to visit and decides that roommates Mark and Vanessa would be the perfect couple. Nicole is upset when Tyler and his friend won't let her play in their boys-only clubhouse.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E21 — Guy's Night Out
Mark tries to help Geneva's boyfriend become a part of his group of male friends with disastrous results. Nicole hides a stray cat in her room, but Vanessa is allergic to cats.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E22 — High Hopes
It looks like Mark, Geneva and Vanessa may all be leaving Oakland forever due to some unexpected surprises--good and bad--in this season finale cliffhanger.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

Mark, Vanessa and Geneva return to Oakland after their plans go awry. Geneva gets promoted to high school principal and wonders if she should rehire Mark.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

Mark takes advantage of Geneva's position as high school principal. Vanessa refuses to return her wedding gifts, which gives Nicole and Tyler a naughty idea.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

Mark becomes the faculty advisor for a student military program and learns that war games are no fun.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

When Mark injures himself, Vanessa proves her medical skills.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E5 — Halloween
Nicole dares Tyler to stay all night in a haunted house on Halloween.Halloween episode.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E5 — The Big Don't Leave Me This Way Episode
Mona becomes completely absorbed in her career as she is working on a talent search idea for Delicious. She realizes that she can't balance work, family and friends and decides that it is okay to focus on her career at this point in her life.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E6 — THe Big No-So Loyal Family Episode
When Dee Dee realizes that Mona has become friends with a woman she has had a long history of competing against, she tells Mona that she has to choose between this new friend and her own sister.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E7 — The Big Don't Go Chasing Waterfalls Episode
To try to give his career a jumpstart, Spencer goes after signing a notorious bad-boy performer, but he has his hands full when the singer isn't as reformed as he led people to believe.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E8 — The Big My Life And Kids Episode
Dee Dee is torn when she gets a date with a great man whom she admires, but she discovers he is divorced with two kids. At first, she rejects the idea of dating him, but she reconsiders and has a great time with his family.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

Mark helps a student basketball player (CHRISTOPHER CARTER) pass an important algebra test. Chris Tucker guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

Mark is given a temporary contract to play professional basketball with his favorite team, the Warriors. Unfortunately, Mark must play guard against basketball star Charles Barkley (HIMSELF). Second of a two-part episode.
